**About Us**  

  

HighLevel is an AI powered, all\-in\-one white\-label sales \& marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, comprised of agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. As of mid 2025, HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2\.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.  

  

**Our People**  

  

With over 1,500 team members across 15\+ countries, we operate in a global, remote\-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.  

  

**Our Impact**  

  

As of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1\.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark \- and we get to help make that happen.  

**Role overview**  

  

You will own who builds on HighLevel and what that ecosystem is worth.



The HighLevel App Marketplace connects third party software companies with more than 1 million businesses. Your job is to bring the right companies into that marketplace, from large platforms with millions of users to specialist tools that serve a single industry well, and then make those launches commercially successful.



This is a partnerships and commercial role, not a product role. You will spend your time in front of partners: sourcing them, negotiating terms, getting them live, and growing what they earn and what we earn. You will also decide where the gaps are. If agencies in the home services vertical have no good scheduling app, you find one or recruit one.



You will report into the Marketplace organization and work daily with GTM, Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Legal and Finance. You will own the number: marketplace GMV and the revenue it generates.

  

**What you'll do**


**Bring partners in**


* Build and own a pipeline of target partners, from major platforms to boutique tools that serve specific verticals.
* Own the full cycle: first conversation, business case, commercial terms, technical scoping with our platform team, launch, and the relationship after launch.
* Negotiate commercial agreements covering revenue share, payouts, exclusivity and support commitments, working with Legal and Finance.
* Be the senior relationship owner for our largest partners, including executive level relationships that outlast any single launch.

**Set the ecosystem strategy**


* Decide which categories we grow and in what order. Build a view of the marketplace by domain, for example CRM, payments, scheduling, creative, telephony and AI, and know where we are strong and where we are exposed.
* Run regular gap analysis using install data, search queries, support tickets and agency feedback to identify what apps our customers need and cannot find.
* Turn those gaps into a target list and then into signed partners.
* Set the standard for what a good partner looks like, so we are not just adding apps but adding apps people use.

**Own GMV and revenue**


* Own marketplace GMV and the revenue we generate from it. Set the targets, forecast them, and report on them to leadership.
* Find new revenue levers beyond simple listing fees, including revenue share models, paid placement, bundles and referral flows in both directions.
* Track the health of the ecosystem, not just the top line: installs, active usage, partner retention, revenue per partner and revenue retention from marketplace apps.
* Work with Finance on multi currency payouts, tax handling and partner billing as we grow across regions.

**Drive go to market**


* Partner with our GTM and Marketing teams on how each launch reaches customers: announcements, in app placement, agency communications, webinars and co\-marketing with the partner.
* Build a repeatable launch playbook so the tenth partner launch is faster and better than the first.
* Open up the reverse channel. Our partners have audiences too, and those audiences should hear about HighLevel.
* Work with Sales and Customer Success so the marketplace becomes a reason customers stay and expand, not just a directory.

**Lead across teams**


* Bring partner and market feedback into the product roadmap. If a major platform cannot launch because of a gap in our APIs or billing infrastructure, you make that case and get it prioritized.
* Represent HighLevel to the developer and partner community at events and in one to one executive conversations.
* Mentor and, over time, build a small team of partner managers as the ecosystem scales.

**What we're looking for**


* 12\+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, alliances or ecosystem roles in software, with clear growth in scope over that time.
* 4\+ years working directly on an app marketplace, developer ecosystem or platform partnerships program in a SaaS company.
* A track record of closing partnerships with well known software companies and getting them live, not just signed.
* Commercial ownership of a number. You have carried a GMV, revenue or pipeline target and hit it.
* Comfort with commercial structures common to marketplaces: revenue share, payouts, referral fees, co\-selling agreements.
* Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation about APIs, webhooks, OAuth and integration scope.
* Strong analytical habits. You can look at install and usage data and tell the difference between a partner that looks good and a partner that performs.
* Excellent communication and executive presence. You will be the face of HighLevel to partners and the voice of partners inside HighLevel.

**Great to have**


* Experience at a B2B SaaS platform with a marketplace, such as CRM, marketing automation, communication platforms or e\-commerce.
* Experience with the agency or reseller model, where your customer serves their own customers.
* A technical background, whether a CS degree or time spent as a developer or solutions engineer.
* Experience launching partnerships across multiple regions, including the practical side of multi currency and tax compliance.
* Experience building a partner program from an early stage rather than inheriting a mature one.

**What you'll get**


* Strategic impact. The marketplace is a growth pillar with visibility at the top of the company, and you will own it.
* Real ownership. This is not a coordination role. You set the strategy, sign the deals and carry the number.
* Strong partners internally. You will work with experienced engineering, product, data and GTM teams who move quickly.
* Room to build. As the ecosystem grows, so does the team around it.

**Why Join HighLevel?**



At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.
  

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well\-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well\-funded and profitable company.
  

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Image Product Manager to work as a part of our Image Processing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the development, enhancement, and management of our hyperspectral image products, working closely with a diverse team across multiple geographic locations. You will play a critical role in delivering high\-quality image products that meet the specific needs of our global clientele..  

  

**Responsibilities \& Duties**:  

* Refine and execute the image product strategy for Pixxel’s image processing pipeline, aligning it with the company’s vision, customer requirements, and future mission needs.
  
* Track current and future mission image product delivery from request to final product packaging and delivery, ensuring timely execution across all stages.
  
* Coordinate closely with IPR, Mission Operations, Platform, Customer Success, Order Desk, QA/QC, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth cross\-functional execution and clear ownership.
  
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer requirement studies to identify trends, opportunities, and product improvement areas.
  
* Create and manage product roadmaps, prioritizing features, dashboard improvements, pipeline enhancements, and operational workflows based on business needs and customer impact.

* Convert recurring team pain points into clear Jira tickets, dashboard requirements, process improvements, and roadmap items.
  
* Maintain a strong functional understanding of hyperspectral image processing, remote sensing technologies, satellite systems, and product levels such as L0, L1, L2, and ARD.
  
* Collaborate with technical experts to understand processing blockers, quality metrics, pass/fail criteria, customer impact, and expected resolution timelines.
  
* Act as a key point of contact for Pixxel’s commercial and customer\-facing teams, understanding their requirements and ensuring that image products align with customer expectations.
  
* Implement and maintain strict quality control processes to guarantee the accuracy, reliability, consistency, and traceability of image products.
  
* Maintain comprehensive documentation, including product requirement documents, release notes, processing version documents, decision logs, issue trackers, and internal/customer\-facing documentation.
  
* Identify potential risks and challenges associated with product development, pipeline execution, quality, delivery timelines, and customer commitments. Develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
  
* Stay current with industry trends, competitor offerings, emerging technologies, and evolving customer expectations to maintain a competitive edge.
  

**Desirable Skills \& Certifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field, such as Remote Sensing, Earth Science, or Engineering.
  
* Proven experience (3\-5 years) as a Product Manager in a relevant industry, with a background in hyperspectral image processing.
  
* Cross\-cultural communication skills, with experience working with international teams. A global mindset and adaptability to different cultural contexts.
  
* Technical knowledge of hyperspectral image processing, remote sensing, satellite systems, and relevant software tools.
  
* Excellent leadership and team management skills, with a track record of successful team collaboration. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects.
  
* Exceptional problem\-solving and strategic thinking abilities.
  
* Strong market research and analytical skills.
  
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with a customer\-centric approach.
  
* Ability to manage budgets and allocate resources effectively. Proficiency in project management and product management tools and methodologies.
  
* Familiarity with quality assurance processes and documentation practices.
  
* Ethical considerations and a commitment to responsible and sustainable practices.
  

  

**Would be great if you have**  

* Mission design and orbit simulation experience using software tools (STK, FreeFlyer, Orekit, GMAT etc.) or custom software is preferred
  
* Full lifecycle development experience of LEO spacecraft
  
* Hardware\-in\-the\-loop and monte carlo simulation experience
  
* Knowledge of Development tools
  
* + Version control (Git)
	  
	+ Project Management (Jira)

**Candidate Acumen**:  

 This is a unique opportunity to lead a dynamic team and shape the future of hyperspectral image products in the satellite industry. If you are a results\-driven Image Product Manager with a global perspective and a passion for cutting\-edge technology, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our visionary team.


**Benefits:**  

 Health insurance coverage  

 Unlimited leaves \& flexible working hours  

 Role\-based remote work and work\-from\-home benefit  

 Relocation assistance  

 Professional Mental Wellness services  

 Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)  

 Employee Stock Options for all hires


**About Pixxel**


Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5\-meter resolution and 135\+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.


Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18\-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full\-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI\-powered analytics.


Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in\-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high\-frequency imagery with AI\-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in\-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.


Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission\-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long\-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space\-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.


Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.

Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world\-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.  

 Central to our employee\-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well\-being and growth in all aspects of life

-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre\-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners .
